title: Neon Wasteland enemy concepts

parameters.prompt: A wiry wasteland raider, the common foot soldier of a scrapper gang: a purple dome helmet with a glowing magenta visor, a patched olive jacket over dark armour plates, a glowing magenta energy blade raised in one hand and a cyan one in the other, neon sneakers with pink and cyan soles. Side view facing right, full body, mid-stride. Hand-inked 2D game art: bold thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colour with one hard shadow tone, gritty speckled grain texture, light from the upper left, dusty gunmetal, olive and rust with bright neon accents in magenta, cyan and orange, a chunky readable silhouette, plain light grey background, no text.

A fast robot attack dog that runs with a scrapper gang: a lean body of riveted gunmetal plates with ribbed sides, thin piston legs, a pointed wolf-like head with one glowing cyan eye and a jagged orange light for a mouth, a short antenna mast on its back. Side view facing right, full body, running. Hand-inked 2D game art: bold thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colour with one hard shadow tone, gritty speckled grain texture, light from the upper left, dusty gunmetal, olive and rust with bright neon accents in magenta, cyan and orange, a chunky readable silhouette, plain light grey background, no text.

A hulking armoured enforcer, a slow heavy brute: bulky grey riveted power armour with huge rounded shoulder pads, a scowling bald face with glowing red eyes inside an open helmet, curved neon tubes in rainbow colours running over the helmet like a crest, three glowing orange vents on the chest, one giant piston fist. Side view facing right, full body, stomping forward. Hand-inked 2D game art: bold thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colour with one hard shadow tone, gritty speckled grain texture, light from the upper left, dusty gunmetal, olive and rust with bright neon accents in magenta, cyan and orange, a chunky readable silhouette, plain light grey background, no text.

A small flying combat drone: a flat dark gunmetal body with four arms and spinning rotor blades, one glowing red sensor eye underneath, yellow and black hazard stripes on its belly. Three-quarter side view facing right, hovering in the air. Hand-inked 2D game art: bold thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colour with one hard shadow tone, gritty speckled grain texture, light from the upper left, dusty gunmetal, olive and rust with bright neon accents in magenta, cyan and orange, a chunky readable silhouette, plain light grey background, no text.

A huge two-legged war mech, the final boss: a boxy olive armour hull streaked with rust, yellow and black hazard stripes, a long heavy cannon mounted on top, a rocket pod with rows of red lights on its side, a glowing cyan reactor core in its chest, thick piston legs with round knee joints. Side view facing right, full body, standing. Hand-inked 2D game art: bold thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colour with one hard shadow tone, gritty speckled grain texture, light from the upper left, dusty gunmetal, olive and rust with bright neon accents in magenta, cyan and orange, a chunky readable silhouette, plain light grey background, no text.
